captions.detailed: A camera speedlight flash unit with a dark matte finish. The assembly features a rectangular main body shell with a rear-facing digital screen and several control buttons, a thin hot-shoe mounting foot at the bottom, and a swiveling neck mechanism. At the top, a boxy rectangular flash head with a white diffuser window is mounted, capable of tilting forward and backward.
captions.instruction: Generate a camera hot-shoe flash with a rectangular mounting foot, a tall rear body with a control screen and buttons, a swiveling neck, and a tilting boxy flash head with a white diffuser window.
captions.factory: Construct the main body shell using a box primitive, and add a thin box at the bottom for the hot-shoe foot. Create a rear control screen and individual raised push buttons using small box primitives. Model the swiveling neck using cylindrical and box joints, then construct the flash head as a box with a separate thin box on its front face representing the white diffuser glass. Assemble the parts using revolute joints for the neck swivel and head tilt, and prismatic joints for the buttons.
